facts.business: Globe Civil Projects Limited is an EPC company executing complex and large-scale projects across education, healthcare, institutional buildings, housing, railways, and urban infrastructure sectors.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Strategy remains firmly anchored around profitable and sustainable growth rather than growth at any cost
Intend to strengthen presence in segments where we have established execution capabilities while selectively expanding into new geographies and higher-value projects
guidance_or_targets.value: Strengthen presence in core segments and selectively expand

guidance_or_targets.statement: Continue to enhance technical and financial pre-qualification credentials to participate in larger EPC opportunities and complex infrastructure programmes

key_risks: Revenue recognition over time for EPC projects involves significant judgements and estimates
Transformation in EPC industry with project owners seeking end-to-end project management and technical competence
Implementation of new Labour Codes effective from 21st November 2025 with financial implications
